title: ENT specialists find otolith damage in Havana syndrome

tellings.quote:
find ENT specialists found that the it's
the ottolith inside the inner ear that
get affected consistently in most of
those cases.

plain: In most cases of Havana syndrome, the unexplained headaches and dizziness reported by US diplomats and spies, ear, nose and throat doctors reportedly found damage to the otolith, a tiny balance organ in the inner ear. A guest named Chris Gilbert says this without naming a source. If true, it would point to a real, physical injury behind the symptoms.
